title: Coin Change Minimum Count
problem: Return the fewest number of coins that you need to make up that amount. If amount cannot be made up, return -1.
edge_cases: No combination of coins matches amount
hints: Use bottom-up DP. State dp[i] holds min coins for amount i. Transition: dp[i] = min(dp[i], dp[i-coin] + 1) for each coin.
